# frontegg_user_env_role (Resource)

Assigns roles to a Frontegg user, either globally or scoped to a single environment.

Each `assignment` block with an `environment_id` gives the user the role only in that
environment. A block without `environment_id` assigns the role globally, in every environment.
Environment-scoped assignments need the `env_role_assignment` feature flag enabled on the account.

The resource manages only the assignments it declares. Destroying it removes those assignments and
leaves the user and its other roles in place. A declared assignment the user already had, such as a default
role or one another resource also declares, is removed too, so declare each assignment in one place only. When a `frontegg_user` manages the same user, leave its
`role_ids` unset to assign global roles here, and don't give it `environment_role` blocks.

Import this resource using the `tenant_id:user_id` format. An import reads every role the user has, so the
first apply after an import removes any of them the configuration does not declare.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "frontegg_user_env_role" "example" {
  tenant_id = "tenant-1234567890"
  user_id   = "user-1234567890"

  # Global: the role applies in every environment.
  assignment {
    role_id = frontegg_role.viewer.id
  }

  # Scoped: the role applies only in the given environment.
  assignment {
    role_id        = frontegg_role.admin.id
    environment_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  }

  assignment {
    role_id        = frontegg_role.admin.id
    environment_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignment` (Block Set, Min: 1) A role assigned to the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--assignment))
- `tenant_id` (String) The ID of the tenant the user belongs to.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--assignment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignment`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role.

Optional:

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment the role applies in. Omit it to assign the role globally.
